# Erdos.p100 — Erdős problem 100

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/100
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/100.lean`, theorem `erdos_100.variants.strong`, AMS 52).

Stronger conjecture: diameter $\geq n - 1$ for sufficiently large $n$.

## Statement
∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ A : Finset ℝ²,
      A.card = n →
      DistancesSeparated A →
      diam (A : Set ℝ²) ≥ n - 1

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
